name: AURIDYN-C2X v1.1
description: Corpus version 1.1.0. Every manifest in this tree carries the same string; quote it with any number you publish, because the corpus bytes move between point releases even when the gold values do not. The changelog is at the end of README.md in the release. A public, scoreable benchmark for turning radio voice, tactical chat and legacy character text into standard-format, schema-valid C2 messages under a byte budget. Everything here is synthetic. No recording of a real person, no real operational traffic, and no classified procedure appears in this release: the scenarios are authored fiction written from publicly published voice-procedure vocabulary.
